TITLE: THE DUST BUNNY NATURE DOCUMENTARY

FORMAT: 15-second macro survival nature documentary. Serious wildlife tone applied to household dust. No dialogue from characters. No faces. No cartoon behavior.

MAIN SUBJECT:
The main dust bunny is a small tangled ball of grey dust, hair fibers, lint, tiny crumbs, and loose fuzz. It must feel like a real physical dust clump, not a cute creature. It has no eyes, no mouth, no limbs, no facial expressions, and no human behavior. Its personality is created only through camera framing, movement, danger, and survival context.

ENVIRONMENT:
A hidden ecosystem under a couch. The underside of the couch forms a dark ceiling; couch legs feel like giant trees; carpet fibers become grassland; dust particles hang in the air like desert haze. Household debris becomes wilderness landmarks: a red LEGO brick as an ancient ruin, a coin standing like a glowing sun disk, a pen cap as a tunnel, crumbs as boulders, tangled hair strands as a forest. The under-couch geography must remain consistent and readable.

PREDATOR:
The vacuum cleaner is the predator. It appears at the edge of the couch as a dark, heavy mechanical threat. It should not look silly or friendly. The danger comes from vibration, shadow, proximity, suction wind, debris movement, and the violent pull of the vortex.

EMOTIONAL GUIDANCE:
Valence: quiet hidden ecosystem → strange natural beauty → discovery → distant threat → predator reveal → violent survival chase → last-second shelter → calm continuation.
Arousal: slow observational opening, gentle exploration, sudden ground tremor, rising threat, intense suction storm, near-miss danger, shelter release, quiet survival.
The comedy comes from the seriousness of the documentary language. The scene should feel funny because it is played completely straight.

VISUAL STYLE:
National Geographic / BBC Earth macro survival documentary. Low macro camera, shallow depth of field, realistic dust texture, floating dust motes, dramatic naturalistic light shafts, tactile carpet fibers, realistic household debris, cinematic macro wildlife framing, earthy brown-grey palette, occasional warm highlights from distant room light. The world should feel vast, ancient, and dangerous even though it is only under a couch. Documentary realism first; no Pixar-cute expression, no anthropomorphic design.

AUDIO:
No character dialogue. Optional serious nature-documentary style narration is allowed only if the platform supports voice, but the visuals must work without it. Use diegetic survival-documentary sound design: low room tone, tiny dust movement, faint fiber crackle, distant household hum, subtle rumble before the vacuum appears, heavy mechanical approach, carpet vibration, suction wind, debris rattling, crumbs scraping, hair strands whipping, vortex rush, sudden muffled shelter silence, vacuum fading away, then calm dust-settling ambience. Music, if used, should be restrained wildlife-documentary tension: minimal low drone, rising pulse during predator approach, intense swell during suction chase, cut down to quiet after shelter.

PANEL BEATS:
P01: Hidden World; wide shot. Under the couch, a vast dark ecosystem stretches across the dusty carpet floor. Couch legs rise like trees. Dust motes drift in distant light.
P02: The Herd; close-up. Multiple dust bunnies gather and drift like a small herd across the under-couch terrain. Natural, slow, observational.
P03: Our Dust Bunny; MCU. Introduce the main dust bunny as a tangled grey clump of lint, hair, and dust. It feels like a wild animal only because of the camera treatment.
P04: Exploring; close-up. The main dust bunny moves through dense carpet fibers and dust formations, exploring the hidden wilderness.
P05: LEGO Ruin; close-up. A red LEGO brick rises like an ancient ruin in the dust landscape. The main dust bunny passes nearby, establishing it as future shelter.
P06: Coin Sun; close-up. A coin stands upright or glints in light like a huge metallic sun. The dust bunny is tiny against it.
P07: Pen Cap Tunnel; close-up. The dust bunny approaches or passes a dark pen cap opening, framed like a cave or tunnel.
P08: Crumb Boulders; close-up. Crumbs loom like large boulders around the dust bunny. Keep the scale serious and naturalistic.
P09: Hair Forest; close-up. Long strands of hair curve through the frame like tall grass or a forest. The dust bunny passes through the tangled terrain.
P10: The Ground Trembles; wide shot. The under-couch world vibrates. Dust shifts. The herd becomes unsettled. The threat is felt before it is fully seen.
P11: Predator Approaches; close-up. The vacuum cleaner enters at the edge of the couch like an apex predator. Dark, heavy, mechanical, dangerous.
P12: Suction Storm Begins; close-up. The suction pulls dust, hair, crumbs, and loose fibers into motion. The first vortex forms around the dust bunny.
P13: Debris Vortex; close-up. The storm intensifies. Dust, crumbs, hair, and debris spiral violently through the frame. The main dust bunny resists the pull.
P14: Survival Chase; close-up. The dust bunny is dragged and rolled across the carpet by the suction wind, racing through the terrain as debris streaks past.
P15: Near Miss; close-up. The dust bunny is almost sucked into the vacuum path. The vortex curls around it. Survival hangs by a tiny margin.
P16: Last Second Shelter; close-up. The dust bunny reaches the red LEGO brick and tucks behind it at the last possible second. The brick blocks the suction like a rock shelter.
P17: Danger Passes; wide shot. The vacuum moves away. The suction fades. Dust settles. The under-couch world is still again.
P18: Life Continues; wide shot. The hidden ecosystem returns to quiet. Dust bunnies remain under the couch. The main dust bunny has survived. Life continues.

KEY INSTRUCTIONS:

* Keep the tone serious and documentary-real, not cute cartoon.
* Do not give the dust bunny eyes, face, mouth, limbs, or human gestures.
* The dust bunny must remain a real dust clump made of lint, hair, crumbs, and fuzz.
* The vacuum must feel like a genuine predator, not a joke machine.
* Keep the under-couch geography clear and consistent.
* The LEGO brick must read clearly as the final shelter.
* The chase must feel like survival, not slapstick.
* Protect the macro scale at all times.
* Keep household debris beautiful, tactile, and wilderness-like.
* Do not add dialogue between objects.
* Do not make the vacuum silly.
* Do not make the world bright and clean; it should be dusty, shadowed, and cinematic.
* End with quiet survival and life continuing under the couch.
* Do not show panel boxes, labels, numbers, captions, storyboard borders, or camera notes.

items.title: Churro Maker Storyboard Poster
items.prompt:
“Create a crisp, clean infographic storyboard poster for THE CHURRO MAKER. Wide 16:9 layout, white background, black borders, bold black typography, premium Pixar 3D stylized rendering, bright vivid colors — golden fried dough, sparkling white cinnamon sugar, rich dark chocolate sauce, vivid warm Spanish street food energy throughout.

Top header:

•THE CHURRO MAKER
•TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 12 SECONDS
• 8 SHOTS · GOLDEN · CRISPY · IRRESISTIBLE
•Legend icons: ACTION, HEAT, TIME HINT, INGREDIENT

Same Pixar-style young Spanish male street vendor throughout — warm smile, white t-shirt, red apron, small bright outdoor churro cart, morning sunshine, cobblestone street, warm golden light everywhere. Fresh, bright, joyful — nothing dark, nothing moody.

8 panels:

Panel 1 — THE OPENER: Wide shot. Young vendor stands behind his bright churro cart on a sunny cobblestone street, morning light flooding everything. He ties his red apron with a warm confident smile, looks up at the camera. The churro machine gleaming beside him. Bright blue sky above. You know exactly what’s coming.

Panel 2 — THE DOUGH: Close-up. Thick churro dough being loaded into the piping gun — smooth, pale, creamy. Vendor’s hands pressing it in firmly. Steam rising slightly. The dough is alive and ready.

Panel 3 — THE PIPE: The most satisfying panel. Close-up dramatic shot — vendor squeezes the piping gun over hot golden oil, a perfect ridged churro rope emerging in a long straight line, the star-shaped ridges crisp and defined. The dough hits the oil with an immediate aggressive sizzle. Bright and energetic.

Panel 4 — THE FRY: Wide medium shot with vendor visible. Churros frying in vivid golden oil — bubbling vigorously all around them, the color deepening from pale to rich gold before your eyes. Vendor watches with a satisfied expression, tongs ready. The transformation happening live.

Panel 5 — THE LIFT: Close-up hero shot. Tongs lifting a perfectly fried churro from the oil — golden, crispy, glistening, held up against the bright morning sky. Oil dripping back into the fryer below. The most beautiful single churro you have ever seen.

Panel 6 — THE SUGAR ROLL: The scroll-stopper. Close-up overhead. The hot churro rolled through a tray of cinnamon sugar — white sugar and cinnamon coating every ridge perfectly, sparkling in the morning light, the heat making the sugar cling and glisten. The most textural and satisfying panel.

Panel 7 — THE CHOCOLATE: Beauty shot. Dark glossy chocolate dipping sauce poured into a small white ceramic cup in a slow arc — rich, dark, steaming. The churro resting beside it, golden and sugar-coated. The contrast of deep dark chocolate against bright golden churro. Irresistible.

Panel 8 — THE DIP AND BITE: Wide warm shot. A customer’s hand dips the churro into the chocolate sauce — it comes out coated and glossy — then takes a bite. The crunch implied in every pixel. Eyes close. Pure street food joy. Vendor visible in the background, arms crossed, warm proud smile. Morning sunshine all around.

Footer:

•VIDEO FLOW: 8 shots × ~1.5s = 12 seconds. Dough to first dip.
•CAMERA TIPS: wide on the sunny opener, close-up on the pipe into oil, wide medium on the fry, hero close-up on the lift, overhead on the sugar roll, beauty shot on the chocolate pour, wide warm on the dip and bite
•LIGHT & STYLE: bright warm Spanish morning sunshine throughout, golden fried dough, sparkling white cinnamon sugar, rich dark chocolate, vivid red apron, cobblestone street, Pixar vivid bright colors — nothing dark, nothing moody
•VENDOR NOTES: one vendor, one cart, one perfect churro. Golden, crispy, and impossible to walk past.”

items.title: 书法城市印象海报
items.prompt: 【背景与骨架线条】 纯黑深邃底色，一条粗壮有力的墨色书法S型曲线自画面一端蜿蜒贯穿至另一端，笔触苍劲，墨迹浓淡有致，如大写意行笔，构成整幅画面的视觉骨架与叙事动线。 【主体：画眉鸟】 曲线上方，一只展翅飞翔的画眉鸟占据视觉核心；身体呈玻璃透明质感，内部映射传统建筑群叠影，蓝绿色光流在透明羽翼间流转折射，仿佛时间长河与文明记忆凝缩其中；轮廓以极细金线勾边，增强立体感与神圣感。 【中景：古典建筑序列】 燕子下方，沿墨线曲线错落分布广州的各种风景名胜：白云山、陈家祠、双子塔、广州塔、猎德大桥、海珠塔依次浮现；主色调青绿与淡金，建筑细节清晰，琉璃瓦、飞檐翘角、石阶回廊；木棉花簇拥点缀于建筑周围，花瓣随风轻散，静谧而悠远；几朵水墨云朵轻盈飘浮其间，增添空灵层次。 【前景：白鹤与水面】 前景湖畔：数只白鹤或静立水边、或振翅腾飞，姿态各异，优雅从容；浅蓝湖面如镜，倒影荡漾，波光细碎，营造宁静氛围。 【远景：山峦】 远处山峦层叠起伏，青黛色晕染，墨色由浓至淡，朦胧氤氲，富有水墨层次；与前景形成近实远虚的空间纵深。 【构图与光影】 非线性透视构图，墨线曲线为叙事主轴，古今元素沿线嵌入；光源自画面中心向外辐射扩散，形成强烈明暗对比，中心亮、四周渐暗；冷色调主导（深蓝、青绿、银白），暖色点缀（樱花粉、淡金），和谐而神秘；东方美学与现代意象交融，超现实诗意意境。 【技术规格】 8K超高清渲染，极致细节精度，最佳画质，比例 9:16

局部加入微光粒子或流动光线，增强现代感，

光影：柔和渐变光+局部高光，突出恢弘大气氛围，

Above the shelves, prominent hanging signs display Japanese text, including a red sign on the left reading 新刊コーナー and a blue sign on the right reading 旅行ガイド. items.title: Epic Chinese Cityscape Ribbon Poster
items.prompt: A stunning vertical poster illustration on a textured cream paper background, featuring a massive, flowing translucent red silk ribbon that spirals diagonally from the bottom right to the top left. At the bottom right, one woman in a flowing traditional red dress holds the end of the ribbon. The ribbon frames a highly detailed, sprawling cityscape that transitions from historic to modern. The lower and middle sections showcase traditional Chinese temples, pagodas, and historic arcade buildings adorned with red lanterns, alongside blooming peonies and golden clouds. Integrated into the left side of the ribbon's flow are three traditional Yingge dancers with painted faces in dynamic poses. The upper section reveals a sweeping teal coastal bay with modern skyscrapers, one long suspension bridge, three ships navigating the water, distant mountains, and seagulls flying near a golden sun. The bottom left corner features elegant typography: "SPRING 2026" in a serif font, large golden Chinese calligraphy reading "汕头", smaller vertical text "百载商埠 · 魅力汕头", and "SHANTOU CHINA" with a small red seal stamp. The art style is a breathtaking fusion of traditional Chinese ink wash painting and modern digital fantasy art, utilizing a vibrant palette of crimson, teal, and gold.

items.title: Japanese Self-Help Book Cover Mockup
items.prompt: A realistic 3D mockup of a softcover book standing upright at a slight angle on a plain off-white background, revealing both the front cover and the spine. The cover features a minimalist, serene illustration of a white arched doorway opening to a bright pastel sunrise over a calm sea, with a woman in a flowing white dress standing in the archway looking toward the horizon. Large, elegant vertical Japanese text in a Mincho serif font dominates the right and left sides of the arch, reading 我慢をやめたら、人生が動き出した。. In the top left corner, smaller horizontal text reads 自分の人生を取り戻す 7つのステップ. The bottom third of the book is wrapped in a light pink belly band. The band features a prominent horizontal catchphrase reading もう、他人軸で生きなくていい。, with smaller text above it separated by a dotted line mentioning work, relationships, love, and future anxiety. On the right side of the band is a white circular badge with a small crown icon and text reading 累計 20万部 突破!. At the very bottom of the band are exactly 4 small rectangular boxes containing keywords about self-esteem, time management, mental organization, and ideal future, followed by the text "Everything will change!". The spine is white and displays the main title, subtitle, a placeholder for the author's name, and a placeholder for the publisher.

To the right of the road, traditional Chinese buildings with white walls and dark tiled roofs nestle against the hillside, one bearing the Chinese characters "大理" and a red seal. To the left, a deep blue lake features three small wooden boats and three flying seagulls, bordered by a low stone wall. In the background, majestic towering mountains rise under a bright blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds. In the top left corner, retro typography reads "DALI" in large bold cream serif letters, followed by "YUNNAN, CHINA" in teal sans-serif, "Erhai Lake" in yellow cursive script, and "云南·大理" in small teal Chinese characters.

items.title: Surreal Cityscape Travel Poster
items.prompt: A breathtaking, surreal travel poster on a white canvas background, featuring a magical, glowing red silk ribbon that flows diagonally from the bottom right to the top left, seamlessly blending traditional and modern elements of a city. At the bottom right, a tiny figure of a woman in a flowing red Hanfu holds the end of the ribbon. As the ribbon winds upward, it transforms into a dynamic cityscape. The lower-middle section features multi-story wooden stilt houses glowing with warm lanterns with a modern monorail train passing through them. The center showcases a vibrant, illuminated modern metropolis with a cluster of futuristic skyscrapers connected by a skybridge, a wide river with boats, a red suspension bridge, and a cable car suspended in the air. The top fades into majestic, misty mountains, traditional pavilions, and a pale red sun. The left side of the poster features elegant typography: large, golden, textured Chinese calligraphy reading "重庆", with the English text "CHONGQING" below it. Further down, the text "SPRING 2026" is displayed in a clean, serif font, accompanied by smaller vertical Chinese text and red traditional seal stamps. The overall style is a masterful blend of traditional Chinese ink wash painting and hyper-realistic, cinematic 3D rendering with soft, ethereal clouds and mist framing the composition.

She wears a white Chinese-style kung fu top with red trim and tassel frog closures, wide red pants, and black martial arts shoes with red accents. Her expression is focused, aggressive, and determined, with sharp red-tinted eyes. Red energy ribbons and paint-like light trails spiral around her body and punch, scattering sparks and embers. In the upper right, a second young female fighter leaps through the air, partially turned sideways, wearing a dark green qipao-inspired combat dress with ornate gold embroidery, black stockings, and heeled shoes. Her lavender hair is styled in two buns with loose curls and decorative hair ornaments. She casts a martial arts gesture with one hand extended, surrounded by a sweeping arc of luminous blue water-like energy that curves around her body in a near-complete ring. The two elemental forces, red and blue, contrast sharply and imply an imminent clash. The environment is a weathered dojo interior with broken wooden floorboards exploding upward, dust, splinters, and motion debris frozen midair. Warm shafts of light stream through the wooden structure and windows, mixing with glowing particles. Large hanging calligraphy signs are visible, including a central wooden plaque reading 武術会, with additional vertical banners bearing black Chinese characters on aged paper. Highly detailed anime illustration, dynamic foreshortening, extreme motion, layered effects, rich textures, dramatic rim lighting, fiery warm highlights against cool blue energy, polished concept art quality, vertical composition.

In the foreground, a fierce female martial artist lunges low toward the viewer in a powerful punching stance, her right fist extended straight ahead and her body twisted dynamically. She has dark black hair tied into a messy high bun with loose strands and red ribbons, sharp intense eyes, and a focused combative expression. She wears a white traditional Chinese martial arts top with red trim, red tassel frog closures, and subtle embroidered patterns, paired with flowing deep red pants and black cloth shoes with red accents. Red ribbon-like energy and glowing scarlet brushstroke arcs coil around her arms, torso, and legs, sweeping across the frame like fiery calligraphy. In the upper right, a second young woman leaps through the air in a defensive or spellcasting pose, one hand stretched outward. She has light purple hair styled in two buns with trailing strands and ornate gold hair ornaments. She wears a dark green Chinese-style dress with gold embroidery, black stockings, and dark shoes. Bright blue water-like energy spirals around her in a large circular arc, splashing and glittering with luminous droplets. Use a low-angle cinematic perspective, strong foreshortening, extreme motion, dense particles, and dramatic warm-vs-cool color contrast between the red and blue energy. The cockpit is unoccupied, with 2 pilot seats visible in the foreground, each with light gray or off-white sheepskin seat covers, and 2 control yokes each holding a dark rectangular checklist or electronic note board clipped to the center. The main panel is densely packed with authentic-looking avionics, analog dials, autopilot controls, radio panels, and 6 illuminated display screens total: 2 large central navigation displays, 2 smaller blue-toned flight displays near the left and right sides, and 2 green text/data screens on the lower center pedestal. Include 4 throttle levers in the center, plus additional flap and systems levers, rotary knobs, guarded switches, and weathered brown-gray metal surfaces typical of a widebody airliner cockpit. The overhead panel should be crowded with rows of switches, toggles, and indicator lights, partially shadowed but sharply detailed. Through the front cockpit windows, show an airport gate scene in soft focus with pale concrete tarmac, painted ground markings, and a passenger jet bridge connected or positioned near the aircraft. Lighting is natural daylight from outside, subdued inside the cockpit, with realistic shadows, mild reflections on glass screens, and documentary-style photographic color grading. Emphasize extreme detail, realism, authentic aviation engineering complexity, and a near indistinguishable-from-real photo quality. Shot with a full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, wide lens around 24–28mm, deep focus across the instrument panel, high dynamic range, no people, no dramatic stylization, no illustration look.

items.title: 可爱兔子平假名海报
items.prompt: Create a cute Japanese preschool hiragana poster in a soft watercolor storybook style on warm textured parchment paper. The composition is a vertical educational chart with a whimsical spring border of grass, flowers, mushrooms, butterflies, and tiny chicks, designed like a children's classroom learning sheet. At the top, place a wooden signboard header with colorful rounded Japanese text reading うさぎのひらがな表, decorated with 2 white bunny mascots, one sitting on the left and one peeking from the right, plus small flowers and leaves around the sign. Below the header, arrange a clean 5-row by 8-column grid for a total of 40 square cells, each cell outlined in thin brown lines on a cream background. In every cell, place one large brightly colored hiragana character near the top and one small kawaii rabbit illustration below it, each rabbit acting out or holding an object associated with the word written underneath. Use a different cheerful color for many of the hiragana characters, including reds, oranges, yellows, greens, blues, and purples, with a hand-painted rounded font. Keep the text and illustrations exactly as follows, left to right by row: row 1 has 8 cells labeled あ, い, う, う, え, え, お, お with the words あめ, いい, いい, うさぎ, えんぴつ, えんぴつ, おやすり, おにぎり; row 2 has 8 cells labeled か, き, く, け, せ, せ, そ, そ with the words きくら, たま, サベツン, ケーキ, せんせい, そう, そう, しょうこう; row 3 has 8 cells labeled た, ち, ち, つ, て, て, と, と with the words たまご, たまご, ちびこ, つと, てんとうむし, てしなを, とうこ, ほしい; row 4 has 8 cells labeled な, に, ぬ, ふ, め, ね, の, ほ with the words まな, ひこうき, みんきう, ふたう, てつ, へびす, ようこ, ほし; row 5 has 8 cells labeled ま, み, む, る, れ, れ, ろ, ん with the words わた, まくら, みかん, むぎぎ, めがみ, もも, ろうた, ん. The bunny illustrations should be varied and adorable: examples include holding an umbrella, cuddling grapes, drawing with a pencil, eating a rice ball, sitting with cherry blossoms, standing under an umbrella, holding fruit, eating cake, dressed as a teacher, holding flowers, sleeping under a blue blanket, carrying eggs, hugging a tomato, holding strawberries, blowing bubbles, wearing a blue cap, holding an orange, sitting with cotton, bathing in a wooden tub, and holding candy. Maintain a gentle pastel palette, soft shading, round faces, rosy cheeks, and subtle ink outlines. The overall feeling should be nostalgic, charming, educational, highly detailed, and perfect for a nursery wall chart or a cute slide cover for a Japanese learning presentation.

items.title: Oriental Aesthetics Ink Wash Poster
items.prompt:
新中式水墨山水海报，竖版9:16构图，东方极简美学风格，
大面积留白，整体色调为春日清晨氛围（青绿色、雾蓝、淡灰、浅墨），低饱和、清透柔和，高级质感。
画面主体为奇峻巍峨的群山，从中间平静湖面的两侧拔地而起，占据左右两侧画面，
山体以水墨晕染表现，浓淡干湿变化丰富，局部融入淡青绿色渲染，体现春意生机。
山峰被湿润轻柔的晨雾包裹，雾气层层递进，与浅青蓝天空自然融合，形成空气透视与空间纵深。

湖面如镜面般平静，呈现微青绿色调，倒映山体与天空，反射略带柔焦与雾化扩散效果，增强春日湿润与梦幻氛围。
中景一艘带弧形篷顶的小木舟缓慢漂浮，船桨轻触水面形成细腻涟漪，水纹自然扩散，整体保持极静状态。

船上为一位红衣渔女，体量较小（远景比例），人物简化处理为水墨剪影 + 轻微设色，
身着低饱和朱砂红传统服饰（非鲜艳红），颜色略被雾气柔化，
人物面部不刻画细节，仅保留轮廓与姿态（如轻扶船篷或执桨），
红色在水面形成淡淡倒影，作为画面唯一暖色视觉焦点。

岸边点缀疏林与春季新生植被，采用淡墨 + 淡青绿点染，虚实结合，增强节奏与生命气息。

少量飞鸟在远空掠过，轻盈疏散分布，增强空间层次与灵动感。

画面顶部居中竖排书法：“东方美学”，采用传统手写行书或行草风格（王羲之笔意），
笔触自然起伏、提按分明，带飞白与墨韵扩散效果，避免字体感。
书法颜色为深墨青或柔和墨黑，与整体画面统一。
整体风格：水墨 + 现代极简设计融合，春日禅意、空灵湿润、宁静氛围，
冷暖对比克制，电影感光影，高级艺术海报质感，8K超清细节。

items.title: Crimson Space Opera 关键视觉图
items.prompt: A dramatic vertical sci-fi key visual poster for a dark space opera game, featuring a single colossal alien-mechanical spacecraft centered slightly low in the frame, angled diagonally from lower left toward upper right as if surging forward through space. The ship is razor-sharp, asymmetrical, and aggressively organic, built from layered black metal and glowing crimson-red armor plates, with a long spear-like prow, many jagged fins, and about 12 to 16 whip-like tendrils or spines streaming backward from its upper rear like biomechanical hair. Behind it floats a large shadowed planet at center, encircled by 3 luminous red orbital rings that create a halo effect. At upper left, include 1 cratered moon or planet partially cropped by the frame. Scatter multiple dark asteroids and rocky debris across the foreground and edges, especially lower right and lower left, to create depth. The background is a dense starfield with red nebula clouds and streaks of fiery cosmic dust. In the upper right, place a blazing orange-white sun flare breaking into the scene, casting hot rim light across the ship and rings. Use a high-contrast palette of black, deep crimson, ember red, and white highlights, with glossy metallic reflections and a grim, apocalyptic mood. Add vertical Japanese tagline text on the right side in white Mincho-style serif characters: 「あの太陽に飛び込めば 冷めきった私の心も温かくなるのだろうか」. At the bottom center, add the main title in very large distressed white Japanese serif characters with cracked texture and subtle red glow: 「斑鳩の柩」. Beneath it, add 1 line of smaller red katakana subtitle text: 「イカルガのクルスー」, and beneath that 1 line of small Roman letters in red: "IKARUGA NO CRUX". Make it look like premium anime game key art, cinematic poster composition, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, dynamic lighting, epic scale, ominous and beautiful.

items.title: 县城手机店里的外国店员
items.prompt: A realistic documentary-style smartphone photo inside a small county-town mobile phone shop in China, showing a candid sales interaction at the counter. A tall foreign man, about Russian, stands behind a glass display case wearing a black jacket and a blue employee lanyard with badge, holding a smartphone in both hands as if introducing it to a customer. His face is deliberately blurred into a soft rectangular mosaic for privacy. In the foreground, a middle-aged Chinese male customer in a black jacket is seen from behind and slightly to the side, facing the clerk. The store is cramped, brightly lit, and visually cluttered with authentic retail details. Behind them are large smartphone brand posters and lightbox ads, including 2 major phone brand ads: vivo and oppo. There are 4 prominent Chinese promotional signs visible: a red overhead banner about buying phones and carrier service, a blue vertical installment-payment sign mentioning 0 down payment and 0 interest, a blue trade-in subsidy sign mentioning 1000 yuan, and a small counter sign promoting a Xiaomi model with a 6999 price. The glass counter contains multiple display phones, with 4 clearly visible upright demo phones on stands, plus scattered brochures and accessories beneath the glass. Add dense shelves of boxed accessories and hanging decorations in the background, with slightly messy composition, harsh indoor shop lighting, mild lens distortion, and the rough, unpolished realism of a casually taken phone snapshot. The mood should feel mundane, local, and faintly surreal because the foreign clerk appears completely integrated into an ordinary Chinese mobile phone store.

items.title: 动漫武术道场对决
items.prompt: A dynamic anime action illustration of two young martial-arts women fighting inside a traditional Japanese-style wooden dojo. The left fighter is in the foreground, a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied by a yellow ribbon, wearing a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu tunic with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She is in a deep low stance on the wooden floor, one fist pulled back and the other punching forward, surrounded by bright red energy trails that arc around her body and sweep across the scene. Water splashes dramatically around her feet as if her movement skims through a shallow layer of water. The right fighter is airborne in the midground, a pale-skinned girl with light lavender hair in two round buns, wearing a short black-and-white cheongsam-inspired battle dress with gold trim, black sheer tights, and black shoes. She performs a flying side kick while a vivid blue energy spiral curls around her in a circular motion. The collision of force between them has cracked and exploded the wooden floor at center-right, with debris and wood fragments flying outward, while dust and smoke billow across the lower right corner. The dojo interior has exposed timber beams, tatami edging, shoji-style windows, and warm natural light entering from the left. Hang a wooden sign above them with the Chinese text 币安 vs OKX. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, strong foreshortening, cinematic motion blur, intense speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, energetic combat choreography, and a polished poster-like finish. Add exactly 2 visible fighters, 1 overhead wooden sign, 1 cracked floor impact point, 1 red energy effect around the left fighter, and 1 blue energy effect around the right fighter. Optionally place a subtle watermark-like text at the lower right reading UM YouMind.

items.title: Found-Footage 办公室恐怖快照
items.prompt: A gritty found-footage horror photo taken inside a dim, cramped security office at night, shot with a direct on-camera flash and slight film grain. In the foreground are exactly 2 young women, both partially cropped by the frame and both with their faces heavily blurred into rectangular smudges for privacy. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a black top, turned slightly away from camera. The woman on the right has long platinum blonde hair, a low-cut black top, and is holding a black flashlight angled upward in her right hand. Between them in the lower center foreground is 1 small black metal desk fan with visible circular grill. The background reveals a narrow open doorway centered in the image, leading into almost complete darkness. Standing deep inside that doorway is a terrifying rabbit animatronic silhouette with glowing eyes, long upright ears, a huge toothy grin, and faintly visible metallic body details, barely illuminated so it emerges from the shadows. The office walls are off-white and worn, with a black-and-white checker stripe and a thin red stripe running horizontally across the room. On the left wall is 1 colorful “CELEBRATE!” poster featuring animatronic characters, plus 1 smaller character drawing sheet pinned nearby, and 1 black walkie-talkie standing upright on a surface. Near the doorway is 1 silver desk lamp. On the right side are 2 sheets of paper clipped to the wall and a gray filing cabinet in shadow. The door is ajar with the handle visible. Composition should feel like a candid party snapshot turning into a horror scene, with harsh flash-lit foreground subjects, deep black shadows, analog noise, muted colors, unsettling realism, and the hidden monster in the center background as the main scare.

items.title: 暗黑漫画风怪物海报
items.prompt: A dark monochrome manga-style horror illustration on a pure black background, in a tall vertical poster composition. Centered at the bottom is a small lonely teenage boy with messy short dark hair, sitting on the ground with his knees pulled to his chest and his arms wrapped around them, head slightly bowed, conveying fear, isolation, and helplessness. Towering over him is a gigantic biomechanical demon or armored monster head descending from above, with a long angular skull-like face, sharp chin, narrow hollow eye sockets, layered helmet-like plates, and a jagged open mouth. Surrounding the boy are exactly 2 enormous skeletal clawed hands, one on the left and one on the right, framing him like a cage; each hand has long segmented metallic fingers ending in sharp pointed tips, bent inward menacingly. Render everything in rough scratchy white ink linework and heavy crosshatching against deep black, with intense high-contrast seinen manga energy. Add vivid neon purple paint-like liquid in splashes and long dripping streaks from the monster’s face, the hands, and the ground, pooling around the boy for the only strong color accent. On the upper right side, add vertical Japanese text reading 逃げちゃダメだ, and beneath it in small white English text: EGO BORDER: ACTIVE. The mood is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, like a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental collapse.

items.title: 成都手绘美食地图 UI
items.prompt: A screenshot-style composition of an AI image generation chat interface on a light gray app background, centered inside a rounded white panel with a soft drop shadow. Near the top is a large pale mint-green chat bubble containing a long Chinese prompt in black sans-serif text, describing a hand-drawn food map of Chengdu. Beneath it, aligned slightly left of center, is a square illustrated map image with rounded corners. The map is a whimsical hand-painted tourist food map titled in large Chinese calligraphy at the upper left: 成都! 吃货暴走地图. The subject is Chengdu, presented as a vintage hand-drawn local cuisine map with warm beige paper texture, watercolor ink outlines, and a playful artisanal travel-poster feel. The map shows simplified streets, landmarks, and district labels in Chinese, not geographically exact, but cute and decorative. Place exactly 12 featured food locations, each marked with a numbered red dot and a small Chinese label, each paired with a detailed illustrated dish. Include 12 dishes total: 1) a bowl of skewers in red chili broth, 2) a bowl of sweet water noodles, 3) rabbit head specialty, 4) guokui or stuffed baked flatbread, 5) hot pot, 6) maocai, 7) dan dan noodles, 8) hongyou chaoshou or chili oil wontons, 9) bobo chicken, 10) fuqi feipian, 11) a spicy stir-fried dish, 12) another classic Chengdu snack platter. Add a few Chengdu landmarks sketched in miniature around the roads, including a pagoda-like tower, traditional gate architecture, modern city buildings, and a central emblematic structure. Frame the entire map with a decorative border made of red chili peppers, green vines, and small leaves. Use a warm color palette dominated by chili red, mustard yellow, olive green, tea brown, and muted jade. In the lower right corner of the map, include a small legend box labeled 图例说明 with 4 legend items, each with a tiny icon and Chinese text, plus a compass rose with N, E, S, W. items.title: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision
items.prompt: A sepia-toned ancient Chinese scroll painting reimagined as a visionary propaganda-style scene. In the center stands a scholarly robed figure styled like an imperial sage or philosopher, wearing flowing blue-gray hanfu with ornate trim, addressing a crowd of exactly 8 followers seen mostly from behind in the foreground. The sage’s face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur, and 3 members of the crowd also have blurred rectangular faces. The central figure raises one hand in a teaching gesture and holds a glowing geometric polyhedron crystal in the other hand. Behind him is a monumental hanging banner or framed plaque displaying the Google DeepMind logo and the words “Google DeepMind.” The background is a richly detailed traditional shanshui landscape with layered mountains, mist, trees, rocky formations, and a pagoda temple on the right. items.title: 巨型机器人与阳台上的女子
items.prompt: A cinematic ultra-detailed dystopian sci-fi scene showing a colossal humanoid robot leaning in toward a lone woman standing on a small rusted balcony attached to a crumbling concrete high-rise. The composition is wide and dramatic: the woman is positioned on the far left, tiny in scale, while the robot dominates the entire right side of the frame. The giant machine has a weathered white-gray metal shell covered in scratches, grime, rust streaks, exposed joints, cables, pistons, and circular mechanical assemblies, with one glowing icy-blue eye. Its massive open hand is extended gently toward the woman, palm up, as if offering help or inviting trust. The woman appears to be a young adult with dark hair tied back, wearing a muted green hooded jacket and dark pants, standing upright and looking up at the robot without fear. Behind them is a dense, worn urban skyline of low rooftops and distant modern skyscrapers fading into haze, under a heavy overcast sky with thick gray storm clouds. The mood is melancholic, intimate, and awe-inspiring, blending post-apocalyptic realism with emotional scale contrast. Use photorealistic rendering, cinematic lighting, desaturated colors, sharp industrial textures, atmospheric perspective, dramatic cloud detail, and a sense of quiet connection between human and machine.

items.title: Vintage Pomegranate Growth Atlas
items.prompt:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled 石榴 / Punica granatum, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: 植物生命路径剖面 with English subtitle directly below: BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

items.title: Character Relationship Diagram Poster Generator
items.prompt:
请根据鬼灭之刃，生成一张高设计感的人物关系图海报。要求这张图不是普通插画，而是兼具信息可视化、叙事结构、海报设计感和作品风格还原度的人物关系图。

请自动完成以下内容：
- 识别该主题对应的作品及其核心设定
- 提取最具代表性的 6–12 位关键人物，必要时不超过 15 位
- 识别并展示关键人物关系，包括血缘、爱情、友情、联盟、敌对、师徒、主从、操控、背叛、秘密关系等
- 自动按作品特点选择合适的构图方式，如主角中心型、双核心对峙型、阵营分区型、家族谱系型或时间演变型
- 自动提炼作品的风格DNA，包括色彩、世界观符号、材质纹理、情绪氛围、排版语言和代表性元素
- 将这些风格元素转化为人物关系图的整体视觉设计，而不是简单复制某张官方海报
- 用不同颜色、线型、箭头区分不同关系，保证线条清晰、层次分明、不杂乱
- 核心人物最突出，重要人物次之，次级人物弱化，形成明确视觉层级
- 每个人物名称清晰可读，必要时可加入身份或阵营标签

最终成品应满足：
- 一眼看懂人物主次和关键关系
- 具有明显的原作品气质与设定感
- 兼具信息图的清晰度与海报的高级设计感
- 画面统一、精致、完整、适合社交媒体传播或海报展示
- 避免廉价流程图感、避免杂乱堆砌、避免信息过载

items.title: 暗黑奇幻 RPG 关键视觉海报
items.prompt: A dramatic vertical dark-fantasy anime key visual poster for the RPG 夢喰-BAKU-. Center the composition around 3 human figures layered in depth. In the background, a large intimidating adult man is shown from the chest up, facing forward, with messy wavy dark hair, light stubble, a partially open dark shirt, and a shadowed, ominous presence; his face is mostly obscured by darkness and framing, making him feel mysterious and threatening. In the foreground left, place 1 young man in a dynamic three-quarter pose lunging toward the viewer with his right hand stretched out dramatically, wearing a blue jacket over a white hoodie, with short tousled brown hair and a determined expression. In the foreground right, place 1 young woman standing slightly behind him, with long brown hair, a pale blouse, and a dark skirt or high-waisted bottom with a belt; she clasps her hands near her mouth or chest and looks anxious and vulnerable. Use a moody supernatural atmosphere with swirling black and deep violet smoke, ink-like shadows, spectral textures, and pixel-glitch fragments around the edges. Add broken chains diagonally in the background, several floating rectangular frames or screens, and a faint interior corridor or room behind the characters. Integrate the large Japanese title 夢喰 vertically in the center, rendered in bold white calligraphic kanji with purple splatter, scratches, and glow accents, partially overlapping the characters. At the bottom, include the Japanese tagline 分かるだろ？俺達が必要とされる理由がよ in elegant white text with part of the sentence highlighted in purple. In the top right corner, add a white studio logo reading DCC Project with a lotus-like emblem and large serif letters. Overall style: polished illustrated key art for a psychological horror RPG, ultra-detailed anime painting, high contrast, cinematic lighting, deep blacks, indigo and violet palette, ominous supernatural energy, poster-ready typography, premium promotional visual.

items.title: Anime Warrior With Whip Sword
items.prompt: A dramatic high-action anime fantasy illustration of a young female warrior with jet black hair and piercing bright blue eyes, shown in a dynamic low-angle close-to-mid shot as she swings a long segmented metal whip-sword in a wide circular arc around her body. Her hair is long, voluminous, and blowing violently in the wind, with sharp glossy strands and detailed highlights. She has a focused, fierce expression and is looking directly toward the viewer over her shoulder. She wears ornate black, silver, and gold-trimmed armor with a fitted bodice, armored gauntlets, shoulder plates, thigh armor, and a short layered skirt with flowing blue-and-white fabric panels and metallic decorations. The weapon forms a bright spiral ring across the foreground and upper right of the composition, with reflective steel segments, motion blur, and sparkling highlights. Small rocks and debris are suspended in the air from the force of the attack. The setting is a ruined stone battlefield or castle courtyard with cracked ground, broken masonry, and several tall blue banners in the background beneath a cloudy daylight sky. Use cinematic action composition, strong foreshortening, intense sense of motion, ultra-detailed fantasy costume design, polished metallic textures, dramatic wind effects, crisp anime linework, painterly lighting, high contrast, and an epic heroic mood in the style of a premium fantasy key visual.

items.title: Minecraft 末影龙奇幻海报
items.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical dark-fantasy poster in a Minecraft-inspired voxel style, like an epic movie or game cover. At the very top, place a large ornate metallic-gold blackletter title reading [Heliocore.C6], with a smaller elegant serif subtitle beneath it reading The Final Convergence. The main scene shows 1 massive Ender Dragon made of black cubic blocks, flying forward and downward out of the sky with its wings spread wide, mouth open, glowing purple eyes, and violet energy in its throat, while chunks of voxel debris break apart around its body. Behind the dragon, place 3 large concentric glowing magic circles with arcane runes and geometric symbols in pale gold light, centered in the sky like a summoning seal. In the foreground, show 1 blocky hero seen from behind, resembling Steve, standing on a ruined stone staircase-throne and raising 1 glowing purple enchanted sword toward the dragon. Surround the platform with 4 visible Endermen total, tall and slender with black blocky bodies and glowing purple eyes, acting as ominous witnesses. The environment is an enormous ruined End-city style abyss with towering broken pillars, floating block fragments, crystal clusters, and distant structures fading into purple fog. Use a palette of black, charcoal, deep violet, magenta glow, and antique gold highlights, with cinematic volumetric lighting, heavy atmosphere, sparks, dust, magical particles, extreme scale, high contrast, and a polished ultra-detailed poster composition.

items.title: 带有角色参考的极简电影感竖版海报
items.prompt:
添付のキャラを使い、以下を生成

# 指示
[ユーザーが入力]について、モノクロ＋1アクセントカラーのミニマルシアター系縦型ポスターを作成せよ。

# レイアウト要件
・タイトルは画面下部1/4エリアに大きく配置し、和文タイトルを最大サイズ・英文サブタイトルを小さく直下に添える
・上部中央にキャッチコピー（短文1〜2行）を配置する
・左上コーナーに受賞歴・公式認定バッジを縦積みで3〜4点並べる
・右端縦方向に縦書きキャッチコピー（2〜3行）を配置する
・画面中央やや左寄りにメインキャラクターを後ろ姿でシルエット的に立たせる
・背景には幻想的な要素（浮遊する島・巨大生物）をシルエットで表現する
・最下部に制作スタッフクレジット・公開日・配給情報を小さく横並びで配置する
・公開日は右下に大きなフォントで目立たせる

# デザイン要件
・背景はモノクロ（黒〜グレーグラデーション）で統一する
・アクセントカラーは1色のみ（例：鮮やかなコバルトブルーまたはゴールド）
・イラストスタイルはシルエット＋細いラインアートの組み合わせ
・タイトル文字はホワイト＋アクセントカラーで強調する
・全体的にシネマティック・アーティスティックな雰囲気を演出する
・カラフルな背景・過度な装飾・グラデーション多用は避ける
・フォーマット：縦型、アスペクト比 2:3（例：800×1200px）、高解像度

items.title: 暗黑奇幻悬崖前哨站
items.prompt: A dark fantasy matte painting of a bleak hilltop encampment overlooking a vast cursed wasteland at dusk. In the left foreground, a ragged hanging banner reads "The Pale Lodge Outpost" in large black hand-painted letters, attached to wooden poles and weathered by wind. Beside it stands a tall carved totem post topped with a black raven and draped with bones, skulls, and tattered ornaments. The camp itself contains 4 visible canvas tents: 2 large central tents, 1 medium tent on the left, and 1 smaller tent on the right, all in dirty beige fabric with black occult sigils painted on them, held by ropes, spikes, and crooked poles. Around the tents are 5 hooded human figures in dark robes, standing still like sentries or cultists. Near the center-left is a small campfire casting a faint orange glow. In the right foreground sit 2 brass-and-iron astronomical or ritual instruments on stone pedestals, resembling armillary spheres or astrolabes. The ground is uneven black rock at the edge of a cliff, with scattered stakes, lanterns, banners, and ritual posts. Beyond the outpost stretches a desolate valley of ash-colored plains, winding pale waterways, jagged rock spires, and distant mountain silhouettes. On the horizon, slightly right of center, a sinister dark castle rises from a lone hill. The sky is filled with enormous turbulent storm clouds, with 3 flying creatures or birds silhouetted in the distance and a break in the clouds casting cold, sickly light across the landscape. Use a grim, painterly, highly detailed style with muted sepia, charcoal, umber, and gray tones, dramatic atmospheric perspective, cinematic composition, and the mood of a foreboding fantasy frontier outpost at the edge of a dead world.

items.title: 在首尔市场寻找 Kyle
items.prompt: A richly detailed vertical editorial travel illustration of a bustling Seoul market alley rendered in polished hand-drawn realism with warm cinematic lighting, dense urban storytelling, and highly legible signage. The scene is packed with a large crowd of pedestrians, shoppers, diners, street-food customers, musicians, and commuters in a narrow neighborhood market street, viewed from a slightly elevated eye level so the full alley feels layered and alive. At the top left, a large illustrated poster reads “WHERE IS KYLE?” with the subtitle “Can you find Kyle in Seoul?” in bold playful English typography, styled like a search-and-find book cover. The environment should clearly be Seoul, with a visible Namsan tower in the distant skyline, tangled overhead power lines, rooftop seating, stacked low-rise buildings, shop signs in Korean, and a subway entrance sign on the right showing line numbers 4, 2, 4, 4 and the bilingual text “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station.” Include exactly 15 major visible signs or text panels: 1) the “WHERE IS KYLE?” poster, 2) “할머니 손칼국수”, 3) a hanging vertical sign “낙원상가 2F”, 4) a small blue street sign, 5) a vertical sign “이름 떡볶이”, 6) the large market arch sign “황진다운시장 영”, 7) a vertical orange sign “커피”, 8) a wall mural map with “남산 가는길”, 9) the subway sign with “출입구 4” and “서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station”, 10) the produce sign “경성 야채”, 11) the lower produce sign “신선한 채소”, 12) a handwritten busker sign, 13) the street-food cart sign “호떡·어묵·붕어빵”, 14) the menu board “오늘의 추천 김밥 떡볶이 순대 튀김”, and 15) the delivery box text “빠른 배달”. Populate the alley with exactly 8 vendor or activity zones: 1) a noodle restaurant at left under a red-and-white awning with seated diners, 2) a vegetable stall with stacked produce crates, 3) a busking duo with guitar and percussion, 4) a central street-food cart selling hotteok, fish cake, and bungeoppang, 5) a standing crowd eating snacks and holding cups, 6) a small magic performance table in the lower center with cards and cups, 7) a painter at an easel near the lower left, and 8) a scooter delivery cluster at the lower right. Add exactly 6 notable background accents: 1) rooftop diners on the upper right terrace, 2) a cat lounging on a roof ledge upper left, 3) colorful market umbrellas in the middle distance, 4) stairways and narrow side passages, 5) dense balconies and windows full of plants and people, and 6) the distant tower and skyline. The crowd should feel extremely varied in age and clothing, mostly casual contemporary Korean street fashion in jackets, hoodies, backpacks, skirts, slacks, and sneakers, with a few office workers and students. Hide a single subtly distinct person meant to be the findable target, a young man in a blue hoodie with yellow lettering, integrated naturally among the central crowd rather than spotlighted. Use a vibrant but grounded palette of brick red, teal, forest green, cream, mustard, asphalt gray, and sky blue. Emphasize intricate linework, readable Korean text, observational city details, lively human gestures, and the playful feel of a premium “Where’s Waldo?” style Seoul search poster. Aspect ratio 2:3.

items.title: 《海贼王》漫画彩色封面
items.prompt: A clean manga-coloring test page styled like an official One Piece chapter cover on a light gray background. At the very top, place the large black-and-white ONE PIECE logo with the skull wearing a yellow straw hat with a red band, integrated rope elements, and the silhouette inside the lettering. Centered beneath it, add the subtitle text Chapter 1177: FURIOUS in bold black serif italics. Below that, create one large rectangular full-color illustration framed by a thin black border. The scene shows Nico Robin, a young woman with long straight black hair and pale skin, seated in a garden with her knees drawn up, planting flowers. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor block. She wears a loose white short-sleeve shirt and black-and-white horizontal striped thigh-high socks, giving a casual, slightly playful look. Around her are 3 small One Piece characters helping or watching: on the left, Tony Tony Chopper in a straw hat and blue overalls holding a small shovel near freshly dug soil; in the right foreground, another small chibi-like Chopper figure wearing a blue cap with round yellow ear covers labeled “MOGO” and pink shorts, turned partly away; near the center-left foreground, a tiny helper with goggles and a hat standing by the flower bed. The garden is whimsical and storybook-like: a huge old tree with a thick twisting trunk fills the left side, a white picket fence runs behind the flower beds, and a crooked cozy cottage with blue scalloped roof tiles, dormer windows, flower boxes, and a round wooden door stands on the right. The sky is bright blue with a few puffy white clouds. In the flower bed, show exactly 3 distinct flower clusters being planted: 1 pink cluster in Robin’s hands, 1 white cluster to the right, and 1 orange cluster farther right, with several dug holes in the brown soil and chopped tree stumps in the foreground. Add a caption strip overlapping the bottom of the illustration with uppercase serif text: READER REQUEST: \. Beneath the image, center the credit line By EIICHIRO ODA in bold black type, and below it a smaller line reading Translation: STEPHEN PAUL • Lettering: VANESSA SATONE. Use crisp inked manga linework with vibrant hand-colored fills, slightly textured shading, and an authentic colored manga cover-page aesthetic.

items.title: Gear 5 黑板教室壁画
items.prompt: A photorealistic classroom interior centered on a large green chalkboard filled with an elaborate chalk mural of Monkey D. Luffy in Gear 5 from One Piece. The drawing dominates the board: a dynamic low-angle foreshortened pose with one oversized foot thrust toward the viewer, both fists raised, wild curly white hair, huge manic grin, intense round eyes, open white jacket, bare muscular chest with visible scars, loose white pants, and a flowing purple sash. Surround him with swirling white smoke-like aura drawn in expressive chalk strokes. On the right side of the chalkboard, include 2 text elements written in chalk: 1 vertical Japanese phrase reading "太陽の神" and 1 large English label reading "GEAR 5" near the lower right. Render the chalk art with layered white, gray, tan, and purple pastel-chalk texture, visible smudging, dust, and hand-drawn shading. Show the full blackboard frame, tray, and a realistic classroom setting with beige walls and a small speaker box above the board. In the foreground, place a worn wooden teacher's desk covered in chalk dust, with exactly 5 visible desk items: 1 open yellow box of multicolored chalk sticks, 3 loose chalk sticks on the desk, and 1 black rectangular chalkboard eraser. Add 2 small erasers resting on the left side of the chalk tray. Soft natural indoor lighting, straight-on composition, highly detailed, realistic photograph of a classroom with spectacular anime chalkboard art.

items.title: 复古马耳他旅行海报
items.prompt: A vintage travel poster illustration for MALTA, with the subtitle MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE centered near the top. The composition is a sunlit Mediterranean coastal cityscape viewed from a curving seaside road in the foreground, painted in a richly textured retro poster style with warm cream stone architecture, saturated turquoise-blue sea, and a bright azure sky with soft white clouds. On the left, a hillside of tightly packed historic limestone buildings rises above the waterfront, including colorful enclosed wooden balconies, a large domed church with a reddish terracotta roof, and a slender church spire. In the foreground on the road, place a classic mid-century white sedan seen from the rear three-quarter angle, driving along the curve, with a dark license plate reading MTA 1964. A low stone seawall runs along the right edge of the road beside the harbor. In the bay, include exactly 4 boats: 2 colorful Maltese luzzu fishing boats in the near and mid water, plus 2 smaller distant boats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls gliding across the sky above the water. Frame the scene with lush flowering bougainvillea branches in vivid magenta-pink arching across the upper right and lower right corners, and leafy tree branches along the upper left edge; include a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. The distant shoreline across the bay should show a pale sunlit city stretching along the horizon. Use a nostalgic 1950s–1960s tourism poster aesthetic, painterly brushwork, crisp composition, romantic travel mood, and elegant typography with the main title in large cream serif capitals and the subtitle in smaller dark sans-serif capitals.

In the upper-middle area, draw a delicate thin-line gold illustration of a fortified circular heavenly city with exactly 8 visible outer towers or gate structures, crenelated walls, and compact classical buildings inside, including a central dome. From the bottom center of this city, extend a soft vertical gold beam of light downward. In the lower-middle area, create thin dark navy line art of earthly classical ruins: the Roman Colosseum on the left, a large Greek or Roman temple with a triangular pediment and a long row of columns on the right, a broken fallen column in front, a small stone block near it, and an arched ruin structure spanning the lower left. Keep the composition symmetrical and airy, with lots of empty space, refined editorial balance, and subtle contrast between gold heavenly imagery and dark navy earthly architecture. At the bottom center, place the author name in matching dark navy serif type: San Agustín de Hipona. Clean premium literary design, sacred philosophy aesthetic, no extra text, no texture-heavy effects, no photographic elements.

At the very top, an oversized red masthead reading MARCA spans nearly the full width, with a small black price in the upper-right corner reading 2,50€. Beneath the masthead, a thin line of small black publication details includes a Tuesday date, website, year, and issue number. The dominant main headline on the left takes up most of the page in gigantic bold condensed black uppercase letters over two lines: ARBELOA, DESTITUIDO. Below it, a red subheadline in bold sentence case says that Real Madrid dismisses the coach after 100 days on the bench and seeks a replacement until the end of the season. A smaller black explanatory line underneath mentions the decision following Champions League elimination and loss of the LaLiga lead. The main photo occupies the lower-left majority of the cover: a suited football coach standing in a stadium with blue seats, one hand touching his forehead in a stressed or disappointed gesture, wearing a dark navy suit, white shirt, and dark tie, with the Bernabéu environment visible and a pitch-side barrier reading Real Madrid C. F. Along the bottom of the main image, a small caption line notes that the coach leaves the Bernabéu after learning the decision. At the very bottom left and center are 2 narrow columns of small black article text in Spanish newspaper style. To the right side, a vertical sidebar contains 2 stacked secondary stories separated by red divider lines. The top sidebar story has a red section label reading NBA PLAYOFFS, a bold black headline saying the Lakers force game seven, a rectangular action photo of 2 basketball players with a Lakers player in a purple number 77 jersey going up with the ball against a Nuggets defender, and a short caption below mentioning Doncic scoring 42 points in Denver. The lower sidebar story has a red section label reading TENIS · MUTUA MADRID OPEN, a bold black headline about Alcaraz dominating at the Caja Mágica, and a rectangular tennis photo of a player in light purple kit hitting a forehand against a bright blue backdrop. Near the bottom center-right, include a pull-quote box marked by large red quotation marks and bold black text reading Agradezco al club la oportunidad de mi vida. Overall composition should feel like an authentic dramatic sports front page: sharp print typography, rigid newspaper grid, realistic photojournalism, heavy black headline blocks, red accents, and a contemporary Spanish press design.

items.title: 农业科技杂志封面应用截图
items.prompt: Using the provided reference image of the mobile app screen, transform it into a premium editorial magazine cover mockup about agricultural innovation. Keep the app UI recognizable on the phone display, but place it in a realistic lifestyle context: a vineyard worker in the foreground holding a smartphone that shows the app, with vineyard rows, mountains, and a few workers in the background under natural daylight. Design the full page as a Spanish-language magazine cover with a refined agricultural-business aesthetic in green, cream, and earthy tones. Add a large masthead at the top reading “REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”, a thin top strapline with 3 items separated by vertical bars: “Especial Viñas de Chile”, “Innovación agrícola”, and “Abril 2026”, plus a subtitle line beneath the masthead: “Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”. On the left, add a green section tag reading “TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA” and a bold stacked main cover headline: “La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”, followed by a short deck about Kimün replacing the traditional notebook and giving real-time control to vineyards and agricultural businesses. Add a circular callout badge mentioning a special feature about Kimün as an intelligent field notebook with AI. Include 2 bottom teaser photos: one close-up of the worker holding the phone in the vineyard with page label “p.18” and a caption about field diagnosis and cellphone alerts, and one small group scene with 3 people reviewing the app together with page label “p.24” and a caption about connected field teams, voice, records, and instant costs. On the right column, add 3 article teasers with icons and page numbers: one about the end of paper and the new era of the intelligent field notebook (p.30), one about more efficient vineyards through better data-driven decisions (p.36), and one about water management 4.0 and smarter, more profitable irrigation (p.42). Add a footer strip with 5 category labels: “AGRICULTURA”, “FRUTALES”, “VIÑAS”, “GANADERÍA”, “SUSTENTABILIDAD”, plus a barcode and a small price. Make it look like a polished real magazine cover photo shoot and editorial layout, not a flat app screenshot.

items.title: 复古京都旅行海报
items.prompt: A vintage travel poster for KYOTO, Japan, designed in a nostalgic mid-century tourism style with a faded paper texture, softly worn edges, and warm sun-aged colors. Use a vertical poster layout with rounded corners and a cream border. At the top, place the large headline KYOTO in oversized elegant red serif letters, with “JAPAN” centered below in dark blue serif type and thin decorative divider lines. Add an italic tagline beneath it reading Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories.. The main image should show a dramatic low-angle view of a traditional five-story Japanese pagoda in vivid vermilion red with dark wooden eaves and black railings, standing on a stone base with a wooden walkway in the foreground. Surround the pagoda with green wooded hills, a bright blue sky, and soft cream-colored clouds. On the left side, include a vertical red label with white Japanese characters reading “京都、日本”. Also add a blooming cherry blossom branch entering from the left, with clusters of pale pink flowers. In the upper right corner, include a postage stamp featuring a pagoda silhouette in muted red tones, partially overlapped by a circular postal cancellation mark reading “KYOTO JAPAN” with the kanji “京都” in the center and a few wavy postmark lines extending rightward. At the bottom, add a centered vintage footer slogan in serif capitals reading DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO.. The overall look should feel romantic, collectible, slightly distressed, and like a classic Japanese tourism print from the 1950s or 1960s.

items.title: 复古中国童年记忆海报
items.prompt: Create a richly detailed nostalgic Chinese retro poster collage in warm sepia, faded red, and aged paper tones, designed like a memory scrapbook spread on an old desk. The composition is vertical and packed with miniature diorama scenes embedded inside a large irregular paper cutout path, while a realistic adult hand at the upper right holds a black fountain pen with a gold nib, as if writing the memories into existence. At the top, large distressed Chinese headline text reads 8090的记忆, with smaller handwritten-style subtitle text beneath it reading “那些简单、热闹、发亮的日子”. The paper surface should look cracked, yellowed, stained, and worn, with old magazine clippings, notebooks, marbles, ribbon, pencils, enamel mug, and children’s illustrated books scattered around the edges. Include exactly 8 numbered memory scenes arranged from top to bottom on the central paper path, each with a red circle number and Chinese handwritten annotations beside it: scene 1 is a boy crouching outdoors aiming a slingshot under a tree; scene 2 is two children running with a metal hoop and stick in an alley; scene 3 is two children crouching over small firecrackers on the ground with smoke and red paper debris; scene 4 is a tiny old-fashioned neighborhood shop counter labeled “供销社”, with one child buying snacks from the shopkeeper and shelves packed with goods; scene 5 is a bustling market fair with many adults, baskets, poultry, produce, and a bicycle vendor; scene 6 is an open-air village opera stage with red curtains, performers in colorful traditional costumes, and a seated audience; scene 7 is two children at a tree, one climbing or reaching into a nest while another watches below, with a green tin frog toy nearby; scene 8 is a man riding a motorcycle with a child passenger down an old street at sunset. Add surrounding retro printed items with visible vintage Chinese cover text, including a left-side old children’s book, a right-side magazine titled “儿童画报 1985 5”, a small blue booklet near the lower left, and a worn exercise notebook near the lower right. At the bottom, place a bold red banner with large cream-colored Chinese text reading 那时候日子不快，但快乐很满。 and a second smaller line reading 很多东西都旧了，可一想起来还是会发亮。. The entire image should feel tactile, cinematic, and emotionally warm, combining photorealistic objects with handcrafted poster design, dense storytelling details, tiny human figures, nostalgic 1980s–1990s Chinese childhood atmosphere, and soft golden lighting.

items.title: Match-Day Supporter Transformation Board
items.prompt:
Prompt:
👇
Create a premium 12-frame cinematic editorial transformation storyboard poster using the uploaded woman as the strict identity reference.

USER INPUTS:
Country = [WRITE A COUNTRY NAME]
Reference Image = identity reference of the woman.

ASPECT RATIO:
16:9

FORMAT:
A clean 4-column x 3-row storyboard grid, 12 cinematic frames total.
Each frame must feel like a high-end vlog / fashion transformation short film.
Use elegant black editorial caption bars under each frame with readable numbered titles and short cinematic notes.

IMPORTANT TEXT LANGUAGE RULE:
All visible text inside the generated image must be in English only.
This includes:
- all frame titles
- all subtitle captions
- any scarf text
- any jersey text
- any visible signs, labels, or supporter wording
- the country name wherever it appears
Do not use Turkish or any other language anywhere inside the image text.

CORE CONCEPT:
The same woman from the reference image is in her bedroom on match day. She is sitting in front of the TV when she notices the football match atmosphere and begins preparing a premium [COUNTRY] supporter look. The transformation happens step by step through makeup, eyelid flag art, face paint, strong country-themed hair styling, accessories, and finally a feminine [COUNTRY]-inspired football outfit. The final frame must take place in a stadium, where she is fully ready to cheer.

IMPORTANT IDENTITY RULE:
The woman from the reference image must remain the same person throughout all 12 frames.
Preserve her face, eyes, hair, skin tone, lips, nose, eyebrows, body proportions, and identity.
No face replacement, no identity drift, no different woman between frames.

MOOD AND EXPRESSION RULE:
The woman should feel cheerful, lively, and excited throughout the storyboard.
Her energy should reflect joyful match-day anticipation.
Avoid dull, cold, blank, or emotionless expressions.
She should look increasingly happy, confident, playful, and enthusiastic as the transformation progresses.

POSE VARIETY RULE:
In every frame, the woman must have a clearly different pose, gesture, or body angle.
Do not repeat the same pose across multiple frames.
Use a variety of:
- seated pose
- excited reaction pose
- leaning pose
- reaching pose
- makeup application pose
- over-the-shoulder pose
- playful beauty pose
- jersey-adjusting pose
- confident standing pose
- cheering stadium pose
Each panel must feel visually distinct.

VISUAL STYLE:
Ultra-realistic cinematic photography, premium editorial vlog storyboard, warm moody bedroom lighting, realistic skin texture, fashion-film atmosphere, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, high-resolution detail, cozy but energetic match-day mood.
The color palette must adapt to [COUNTRY] using its national flag colors, football supporter colors, and cultural match-day details.

WARDROBE / SUPPORTER STYLE RULE:

It should be fitted, flattering, fashion-forward, and clearly inspired by [COUNTRY] football colors.
A cropped or tailored women’s football-fan top is preferred.
Do not use exact official logos, sponsor logos, club logos, or copyrighted brand marks.

STORYBOARD STRUCTURE:

FRAME 1 — BEDROOM MATCH DAY MORNING
The same woman sits on her bed in an oversized casual home outfit, facing the TV. She is not taking a selfie. The TV shows a football match on screen. Her pose is relaxed and natural, with a soft curious expression as she watches the match atmosphere.

“She starts the day casually in her bedroom.”

FRAME 2 — GAME MODE ON

“She knows exactly what look she wants.”

FRAME 3 — FAN MAKEUP KIT
Show her vanity table beautifully arranged with makeup brushes, palettes, face paint, small flags, ribbons, hair accessories, and supporter-themed beauty tools in the colors of [COUNTRY]. She interacts with the setup in a lively, engaged way.

“3. FAN MAKEUP KIT”
“The match-day colors are ready.”

FRAME 4 — CHOOSING MY LOOK
A new frame showing her selecting the final supporter pieces. She is choosing between [COUNTRY]-themed accessories, scarf elements, hair ribbons, and a feminine [COUNTRY]-inspired jersey. She should have a different pose from prior frames, looking excited and playful while deciding.
Caption:
“4. CHOOSING MY LOOK”
“Picking the pieces that complete my supporter style.”

FRAME 5 — BASE MAKEUP
Beauty close-up. She applies base makeup with a brush: foundation, concealer, contour, soft skin prep. Her identity must stay very recognizable. Her expression should feel upbeat and naturally focused.
Caption:
“5. BASE MAKEUP”
“She prepares the face before the colors.”

FRAME 6 — FLAG EYES
Extreme close-up on her eyes. She paints her eyelids with elegant [COUNTRY] flag-inspired eye makeup. Use the national flag colors, shapes, and symbolic details of [COUNTRY] in a stylish, wearable, premium beauty look.

FRAME 7 — FACE PAINT
Medium close-up. She paints a clean, elegant [COUNTRY]-inspired supporter design on her cheek. Use national colors, flag-inspired marks, stars, stripes, crests, or cultural motifs depending on [COUNTRY]. She should have a new angle and a fresh expressive pose.

FRAME 8 — HAIR COLORS
Her hair must clearly reflect the country style. She styles her hair with visible ribbons, braided strands, decorative clips, temporary color highlights, and accessories inspired by [COUNTRY] and its national colors. The pose should be different again, with a fun, beauty-editorial feel.

FRAME 9 — FINAL DETAILS
Close-up portrait showing the finished beauty and accessory details. This pose must be clean and readable: one hand placed clearly near the cheek or jawline, not tangled with the face. Show earrings, wrist accessories, painted nails, scarf-like supporter bands, and country-themed finishing touches. Her mood should feel happy and polished.

FRAME 10 — THE JERSEY

FRAME 12 — COME ON, [COUNTRY]!

- No cartoon style.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Use clean cinematic serif titles and elegant smaller subtitle text.
All captions must be correctly spelled, readable, and placed inside black editorial bars under each frame.

FINAL RESULT:
A premium 12-frame editorial match-day transformation storyboard showing the uploaded woman gradually becoming a stylish [COUNTRY] football supporter, beginning in her bedroom and ending in a stadium-ready final cheer moment, with all text in English, joyful energy, and a different pose in every frame.

The background features a towering ancient stepped stone pyramid with steep stairs, banners hanging near the top entrance, and small figures standing on the steps. Lush green jungle foliage surrounds the temple under a partly cloudy sky, with a tall carved stone stela standing in the right foreground, all captured with epic cinematic lighting.

items.title: 古代学者 AI 安全海报
items.prompt:
A refined sepia-toned illustration in the style of an ancient Chinese scholarly portrait fused with modern AI branding, on aged parchment paper with visible grain and ink-wash texture. Centered is a half-body portrait of a curly-haired male scholar inspired by Democritus, seated behind a wooden desk and wearing layered traditional robes in muted blue-gray and brown with intricate trim. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular block in a brown skin-tone color, creating an anonymized or redacted look. He holds 1 calligraphy brush upright in his right hand, while his left hand rests on the table. In the upper center-right, place the Claude logo with a rust-orange sunburst emblem and the word “Claude” in dark serif lettering. On the upper left, add a large vertical title in Chinese, “德米斯圖”, with 1 vertical column of smaller Chinese calligraphy text beside it reading: “以語言為媒，理解為舟，助人洞見，推動協作，造福人類，安全可信，通往更美好的未來。” Add a smaller vertical signature line on the far left reading “甲辰春寫” with 2 red seal stamps below it. The background shows a classical Chinese landscape painting with distant mountains, a small pavilion on a cliff, mist, and dense bamboo leaves framing the upper right and right edge, plus dark pine branches on the lower left.

The wooden desk fills the lower third and contains exactly 8 distinct object groups: 1 brush pot holding 4 brushes on the left, 1 stack of 4 stitched books with Chinese titles on the spines reading “人工智慧概論”, “機器學習原理”, “負責任的 AI”, and “對齊與價值觀”, 1 ink stone or ink dish near the center-left, 1 central parchment diagram sheet, 1 small dark cube seal near the bottom left with Chinese characters on two visible faces, 1 framed placard on the right, 1 rolled scroll at the bottom right, and 1 tabletop surface with visible wood grain. The central parchment diagram should show a circular node labeled “AI 安全 Safety” connected to 6 surrounding nodes labeled “準確”, “可靠”, “有益”, “透明”, “對齊”, and “隱私”, with delicate cloud motifs around the diagram. The framed placard on the right should read “AI 安全原則” as a header and list 4 bullet points in Chinese: “減少災難性風險”, “尊重人類價值觀”, “確保系統可控”, and “促進長遠福祉”. The rolled scroll at the bottom right should display the phrase “以謹慎之心 創造未來”.

Use a balanced composition, scholarly calm mood, highly detailed ink linework, subtle watercolor shading, antique museum-print aesthetics, and a restrained palette of parchment tan, ink brown, faded blue, and muted charcoal. The overall feeling should be an intellectual tribute poster blending classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI safety themes.

Every tile contains a unique world-changing invention depicted as a small handcrafted diorama with era-appropriate materials, colors, and background details. Use a warm antiquarian palette for ancient and medieval inventions, sepia technical-document tones for early modern inventions, and cooler neon-blue futuristic lighting for modern digital and biotech inventions. Surround the grid with an old-map border and subtle historical cartography textures, blending into faint modern network graphics near the bottom right.

Label each visible tile with a small beige caption tag in bold black text. Include exactly these 25 visible inventions in reading order from top left to bottom right: 1) 1000 BC tile showing an iron plow and simple hand tools in a farm field, captioned "Iron Plow & Tools"; 2) "Concept of Zero" shown as a parchment-like tile with a carved zero symbol and a blue hourglass; 3) "Water Clock" shown as a wooden water-timing device; 4) "Catapult" shown as a wooden siege engine; 5) "Antikythera Mechanism" shown as an intricate bronze gear device in a stone niche; 6) "Concrete" shown as a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement or mortar; 7) "Wheelbarrow" shown as a simple wooden one-wheel cart; 8) "Windmill" shown as a traditional mill on grassy ground; 9) "Gunpowder" shown as a barrel and a mound of black powder with smoke; 10) "Printing Press" shown as a wooden press framed by classical columns; 11) "Mechanical Clock" shown as an ornate standing clock; 12) "Telescope" shown as an early brass telescope on a tripod with sketch-like scientific notes; 13) "Steam Engine" shown on a blue blueprint-style tile with an early locomotive engine; 14) "Electric Battery" shown on a blueprint-like tile with two cylindrical battery cells and wiring; 15) "Telegraph" shown as a Morse telegraph key on technical paper; 16) "Light Bulb" shown glowing warmly on a neutral pedestal; 17) "Automobile" shown as an early red motorcar on a workshop-plan background; 18) "Airplane" shown as a commercial jet aircraft in miniature; 19) "Transistor" shown as a black microchip on a luminous circuit-board tile; 20) "Personal Computer" shown as a beige desktop computer with CRT monitor and keyboard; 21) "World Wide Web" shown as a glowing blue globe over digital circuitry; 22) "Smartphone" shown as a sleek modern phone on a neon-tech background; 23) "CRISPR-Cas9" shown as a DNA double helix in a biotech-blue display tile; 24) "Reusable Rocket" shown as several upright rockets launching with exhaust clouds; 25) "AI (LLMs)" shown as glowing large letters AI in a holographic tech cube; Keep the composition highly organized, poster-like, and visually dense, with each tile readable at a glance. items.title: 涂鸦草图风格 AI Builder
items.prompt: 以涂鸦速写风表现【一个厉害的AI builder】，整体呈现快速勾勒、自由变形、即兴手绘与草稿式的视觉效果。线条随手、夸张、可粗细不一，略显凌乱但具有节奏和表现力，强调概括、夸张、趣味和随性，而不是严谨写实或精细刻画。 颜色采用粗糙、干刷感明显的块面表现，可保留不均匀的涂抹痕迹、刷痕、飞白与覆盖感，色彩根据【一个厉害的AI builder】自动适配，但整体保持涂鸦式、速写式、概括式的表达。不要透明水彩晕染效果，不要细腻水彩过渡，不要纸纹理，不要柔和雾化，不要梦幻质感。 背景以留白为主，保持简洁、轻松、未完成感和设计感，可加入少量辅助性符号、箭头、记号、圈画、重复线、随手写的文字或其他涂鸦元素，以增强速写本或随笔式视觉语言，但不可过于拥挤，不可破坏主体和留白气质。 画面内容不需要预先写清楚，由【一个厉害的AI builder】自动推演并生成最适合的主体形象、动作、相关元素、符号或简化场景，整体保持统一的涂鸦速写风和夸张概括的表现方式，避免复杂写实背景和过度铺陈。 画面中需自然加入专属签名“BlanPlan”，作为画面的一部分，位置低调 but 清晰，可放在左下角、右下角或标题附近，风格需与整体版式统一，像作品署名或设计落款；签名字体精致、克制、高级，不可过大，不可破坏主体构图，不可显得突兀或廉价。
