items.prompt: 一幅令人叹为观止、极其复杂的「儒释道根本区别」概念世界构建信息图杰作，整体被设计成一部底蕴深厚的东方古典神话传说手稿。背景：纯白色复古纹理画布，浅米黄做旧牛皮纸底色，轻微毛边与水渍感。核心布局：中心视觉采用宏大的「竖版蛋形分层结构」，从上到下依次为释、道、儒三层。边缘边角料：四个角落点缀精细微观插图，主题为古代观测手记、法器与符文。色彩：低饱和鼠尾草绿、浅金、米白为主色调，整体清淡柔和，无刺眼高饱和色彩。细节：建筑线条、山水皴法、莲花纹路、云气层次清晰可见，纤毫毕现。无缝融合：三层之间通过云雾与水流自然过渡，释的佛光、道的太极云气、儒的书卷气息无缝衔接。风格：古典墨水线稿+低饱和数字水彩，清淡国风古籍手稿质感。文字标注：纯正繁体汉字，采用斑驳古风宋体，每个标注含短标题+一行诗意描述，由暗金色发丝引线连接对应细节，无重复指向。画幅比例：3:4竖版独立完整标题区（顶部）：`儒釋道·根本區別`中心分层标注：顶层「釋」：`釋`，`人與自己的關係`，`無我·治心·放得下`中层「道」：`道`，`人與萬物的關係`，`無為·治身·想得開`底层「儒」：`儒`，`人與人的關係`，`無己·治世·拿得起`左右辅助标注：左侧：`淨`，`清淨明心，斷除煩惱`；`靜`，`順應自然，回歸本心`；`敬`，`敬畏責任，積極入世`右侧：`60歲+修心`，`看淡得失，回歸內心`；`35-55歲做人`，`張弛有度，順應規律`；`7-35歲做事`，`銳意進取，建功立业`底部总结文字：`入世與出世之間的平衡，是高級的生活智慧`

The calligraphy should be highly legible expressive Chinese cursive-regular script with varied ink density and natural brush taper, reading from right to left in 6 columns: "金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱", "停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然", "欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山", "闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边", "行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在", "长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海". Add one smaller vertical inscription on the left side reading "李白行路难" with a small red seal stamp beneath it. In the lower left foreground, depict an ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing white and pale gray robes with a blue sash, long black hair in a traditional topknot with loose strands and ribbon, standing on the edge of a dark rocky cliff, body angled right and head lifted upward in a contemplative, heroic pose. Below and across the lower half, paint a turbulent river or sea with white crashing waves in monochrome ink and soft gray washes; in the distance, faint misty mountains and fog dissolve into the paper. Classical literati painting style, dynamic calligraphy as the main focus, poetic and majestic mood, restrained palette of black ink, gray wash, off-white paper, and a small touch of muted blue on the robe, ample negative space, museum-quality Chinese shanshui and calligraphy fusion.

The exact text of the 6 columns is: “金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”, “停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”, “欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”, “闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”, “行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”, “长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”. items.title: 拳击冲击聊天截图
items.prompt: A realistic smartphone screenshot of a dark-mode chat interface in Chinese, minimalist and modern, with a charcoal black background and lots of empty space. Near the upper right is a single rounded dark-gray message bubble containing the white Chinese text 拳击手被击中的瞬间. Below and to the left is one large embedded photo with rounded corners, occupying most of the lower-left half of the screen. The embedded photo shows the exact instant in a professional boxing match when one boxer lands a hard straight punch flush on the other boxer’s face. Two shirtless male boxers with muscular, sweaty bodies are inside a ring under arena lights. The boxer on the right is seen mostly from the back and side, extending his right arm fully across the frame; his back and shoulder muscles are sharply defined, and he has short dark hair and tattooed arms. He wears a white boxing glove with blue trim, and the glove is smashing into the left boxer’s face. The boxer on the left is recoiling from the impact, his head snapping sideways, with a spray of sweat and water droplets exploding outward around his head. He has a heavily tattooed left arm and chest, a black glove raised near his torso, and black trunks with large gold letters reading VICTOR across the waistband area. items.title: Donut Heist Storyboard Sheet

Title: “THE DONUT HEIST”
Subtitle: “15s Comedic Storyboard – 9 Shots”

Style: full-color 3D animated storyboard sheet, cinematic cartoon characters, polished lighting, expressive faces, vibrant colors, red panel borders, blue camera/action arrows.

Characters: chubby food-obsessed raccoon with striped tail. Small hyperactive squirrel with fluffy tail.

Important: keep left-right continuity. Squirrel always rushes from screen left to right, looking toward the bench/raccoon, never away. Raccoon stays near the donut box. In panel 03, the raccoon hears rustling from screen left and looks that way.

Each panel: timecode, shot type, camera move, short action note.

01 0–1.5s Wide/static: raccoon finds donut box on park bench.
02 1.5–3s Med/push-in: raccoon opens box in awe.
03 3–4.5s MCU/pan: raccoon hears rustling from screen left and looks that way, suspicious.
04 4.5–6s Wide/tracking: squirrel sprints toward bench, eyes locked on donuts.
05 6–7.5s Med/push-in: raccoon protects donut box.
06 7.5–9s Close/forward: squirrel crashes into raccoon, donuts fly.
07 9–11s Close/tight: both scramble for falling donuts.
08 11–13s Med/static: both freeze, holding half a donut.
09 13–15s Wide/final hold: they glare, then bite at once.

Right side: character sheet + palette: sunny park, green grass, raccoon grey-brown, squirrel orange-brown, pink icing.

items.title: Urban Street Style Character Study
items.prompt: 该画面为中近景，采用平视镜头，聚焦于一位年轻女性。她以七分身镜头呈现，身体坐姿略带倾斜，臀部向后撅起，双腿自然交叠，左腿在前，右腿在后，膝盖微屈。她将上半身向右后方扭转，头部则转向镜头方向，形成一个经典的“回眸”姿态，目光直视镜头，眼神清澈而略带一丝俏皮。她的发型是蓬松的棕色齐肩短发，刘海自然垂落，发尾微卷，妆容清淡自然，仅在眼部有轻微眼线勾勒，唇色为自然裸粉。画面整体采用自然日光滤镜，光线从画面左上方斜射入，形成柔和的逆光轮廓，面部和身体右侧被温暖的金色光线照亮，左侧则形成自然的阴影过渡，增强了立体感。灯光效果是明亮的自然光，带有轻微的镜头眩光，营造出午后阳光的氛围。拍摄角度为平视，构图上，人物主体位于画面中偏右位置，背景中的斑马线与道路线条形成自然的引导线，将视线引向人物。背景为城市街道，包含道路、斑马线、绿化带和远处的车辆，背景被适度虚化，但依然可辨识出树木、护栏和停放的电动车等元素，构图上利用了三分法，人物位于右侧三分之一处，增强了画面的平衡感。主体穿着一件军绿色迷彩图案的连帽卫衣，下身搭配黑色短裤，脚穿白色高帮运动鞋配白色中筒袜。背包为黑色，带有橙黄色装饰条纹和一个橙色毛绒挂件，材质为帆布和皮革拼接。整体风格为街头休闲风，肢体语言放松自然，表情略带好奇与俏皮，整体呈现出一种随性、青春、充满活力的都市少女形象。

The slide contains math text: "Example 3: Find the sum of the infinite geometric series. 1/3 - 1/9 + 1/27 - 1/81 + ... Solution: The series is geometric with a = 1/3 and r = -1/3. Since |r| < 1, the infinite geometric series converges. S = a / (1 - r) = (1/3) / (1 - (-1/3)) = (1/3) / (4/3) = 1/4. The sum of the series is 1/4." The slide footer reads "Dr. Larson", "Calculus II", "11/14/2024", and "7 / 35". The right panel shows vertical Minecraft parkour gameplay, featuring floating wooden blocks over a grassy landscape with a TikTok watermark at the bottom right. The room has a drop ceiling and blackboards visible behind the screen edges.

- character identity

white body contour lines

construction-line feeling
anatomy guide lines visible

items.prompt: A vast ultra-wide cinematic fantasy xianxia world map painted as a highly detailed Chinese cultivation sect panorama, viewed from an elevated distance above a sea of clouds. The scene shows a majestic mountain realm made of many steep rocky islands, waterfalls, mist-filled valleys, floating stone shards, ornate bridges, and layered traditional Chinese palace architecture with glowing mystical blue energy. In the center, place the grand main sect complex labeled "玄天剑宗", built on the tallest luminous mountain with white-blue crystal light, ascending pagodas, terraces, and celestial aura; nearby add the smaller label "宗门大殿". Surrounding it, include exactly 9 additional labeled locations distributed across the panorama: on the far left a purple-toned cliff region labeled "问剑崖" with the smaller annotation "弟子历练之地"; left-center a blue misty cultivation platform island labeled "悟道峰" with the smaller annotation "弟子悟道之地"; upper left a solemn hall cluster labeled "藏经阁" with the smaller annotation "典藏无上功法"; upper right a jagged icy mountain sword formation labeled "剑冢" with the smaller annotation "历代剑修终寝之地"; right-center a bright ceremonial complex labeled "演武场" with the smaller annotation "磨砺弟子心性"; lower right-center an alchemy pavilion area labeled "炼丹房" with the smaller annotation "炼丹疗法"; far right a pink flowering valley sanctuary labeled "百花谷" with the smaller annotation "入神绮艳秘境"; bottom right an outer compound labeled "外门" with the smaller annotation "新弟子居所". Add one title inscription in the upper left corner reading "玄天剑宗" in large gold calligraphy, with a smaller poetic line beneath it and a small red seal stamp. items.title: 四格浪漫喜剧漫画页面
items.prompt: Create a black-and-white manga page with 4 stacked horizontal panels, clean black gutters, screentone shading, dramatic speed lines, and polished seinen-style linework. The page features two youthful anime characters with modern casual clothing and short dark hair, with the face area of both characters obscured by a soft square blur censor block. Panel 1: a slim young person with messy short dark hair and a collared shirt clenches one fist near their chest, body angled left, surrounded by an intense fiery aura effect in the background, looking emotional and defensive. On the right side, place a large jagged vertical speech balloon containing this Japanese text: 「何十時間も魂を削って描いた一枚と、プロンプト打ち込んで数秒で出した画像が同じ価値なわけないでしょ！ふざけないで！」. Panel 2: a second young person with slightly taller build, short dark hair, a dark zip jacket over a light shirt, raises one index finger calmly as if explaining a point. Add a rounded rectangular speech box on the right with this Japanese text: 「投下した労働時間で価値が決まるという典型的な“労働価値説の誤謬”だ。市場における価値は、出力された結果を受け手がどう評価するかで決まる」. Panel 3: the taller character gently pats the shorter character on the head; include a small hand-pat sound effect near the hand reading 「ポン」. The shorter character looks up in surprise. On the right side, add a large oval vertical speech balloon with this Japanese text: 「でも俺の市場価値基準はすごくシンプルだよ。君が俺のために照れてくれるこの数秒間に、何十時間分の価値も感じてるから」. Panel 4: close-up of the shorter character blushing intensely with spiral eyes, sweat drops, trembling expression, open mouth, and dense hatching on the cheeks, overwhelmed with embarrassment. Fill the background with dramatic radiating speed lines. Add a large jagged vertical speech balloon on the right with this Japanese text: 「だ、誰がアンタのために照れるか…っ！自意識過剰よ！」. Add two sound effects: a small 「プル…」 near the shoulder and a larger shaky handwritten 「カァァァ」 along the lower left side. Keep the whole page monochrome, highly expressive, romantic-comedy manga tone, with strong emotional contrast between heated argument, cool explanation, teasing affection, and flustered payoff.

The character’s head is replaced by a large white doodle coffee-cup face icon with a smiling expression and ruler-like tick marks across the top rim. To the right are 3 rounded-rectangle photo panels, evenly spaced. In panel 1, the model sits in a folding chair reading a magazine and holding a green mug, with a dark Nike duffel bag on the floor and a few scattered cups nearby; the white doodle cup head has 2 steam squiggles rising above it. In panel 2, the model stands beside a pyramid made of approximately 28 stacked green and white paper cups, one arm resting on the top; they wear a soft green Nike T-shirt and shorts set, white socks, and white sneakers; a small white typographic logo in the upper left reads like a cafe or service-court brand mark. The doodle cup head here is a simple smiling cup with a wide rim. In panel 3, the model leans casually with crossed legs, holding a green cup, next to a small wire cart containing green tennis balls and topped with a retro CRT television; they wear a white polo shirt, mint shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. The doodle cup head in this panel has horizontal stripe bands across the top. Keep all faces fully replaced by the graphic cup icons, with no real facial features visible. Use a soft studio setup, flat even lighting, subtle shadows, matte textures, and a highly consistent mint, sage, olive, and white color story. Add thin white horizontal guide lines across the blue background near the top and bottom. Place small gray editorial footer text at the bottom: on the left, “MJ REFERENCE”; on the right, “KREA // GPT 2”. items.title: 彩色少年漫画战斗页面
items.prompt: A fully colored shonen manga action page in the style of a high-energy pirate battle comic, presented as a single comic page with 4 visible panels separated by thick white gutters and slightly tilted panel borders. Use bold black ink lines, dense crosshatching, speed lines, cel-style coloring, dramatic foreshortening, and exaggerated impact effects. The scene shows a muscular, towering giant warrior with tan skin, a horned helmet, wild black hair and beard, fur-trimmed black clothing, a wide studded metal belt, and a massive spiked club, battling a swordsman in dark blue clothing and armor-like headgear. Top panel: an extreme close-up of a huge clenched fist thrusting toward the viewer with explosive perspective, the giant shouting “GUNGNIR !!!” in a jagged speech balloon, and another balloon reading “GWOAH !!!”; add large red Japanese sound effects and a small “DOOM!!” impact text. Middle wide panel: the giant swings upward and roars “IKOKU SOVEREIGNTY !!!” while the blue-clad opponent recoils at left; include a speech balloon saying “GAH!” and large purple Japanese sound effects with a small “WHONK!!”. Bottom left narrow panel: a cropped close-up setup panel with two stacked speech balloons reading “THREE SWORD STYLE.” and “RED OGRE…”, with the speaker mostly off-frame and partially obscured. Bottom right large panel: the giant drives a massive wooden spiked club across the frame in a violent horizontal smash, shouting “GIANT TROMMA !!!”; include smaller impact balloons reading “DWUAH !!!” and “THWAM!!”, plus oversized red Japanese sound effects. Backgrounds should be mostly pale sky blue with heavy motion lines and flying debris. Preserve the feel of a professionally colored weekly manga page: saturated reds, blues, purples, tan skin tones, cream fur textures, black shadows, and crisp white speech balloons with hand-lettered comic text.

items.title: 抽象混乱风格角色艺术
items.prompt:
# 混沌としたメモ書き・記号の集合体からキャラクターの顔を浮かび上がらせるアート

---

## スタイル
- 白い紙の上に黒インクで描かれた大量の手書きメモ、数式、記号、ランダムな線。
- 紙いっぱいに散らばる書き殴り風のカオス。
- 所々に赤インクの強調（ライン、塗り潰し、マーカー風の塊）。
- アナログのノート落書きのような質感。

---

## 構図
- ランダムなメモや記号が全体を覆い尽くす。
- 黒インクの線や文字の密度が「キャラクターの顔」の位置に集中する。
- 結果として、混沌の中から「与えられたキャラクターの顔のシルエット・表情」がうっすら浮かび上がる。
- 顔は写実的ではなく、カオスの断片が集まって形を成す。

---

## 色彩
- モノクロ（黒・白）を主体に構成。
- 赤インクをアクセントとして散発的に配置。
- 彩度は抑えめ、アナログの紙とインク感を重視。

---

## 表現要素
- 読めるようで読めない文字列、日本語や英数字が混在。
- 数式記号、矢印、点、斜線、クロス、ドリップ（インクの飛び散り）。
- キャラクターの顔の目や髪の輪郭は、メモや記号の配置の「余白」や「濃淡」で浮かび上がる。

---

## 禁止事項
- 顔を直接的に描き込む写実ポートレート。
- デジタル処理的で整然とした幾何学模様。
- カラフルな彩色や過飽和表現。
- ロゴ、透かし、人工的なCG感。

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- 全体は「混沌としたメモ・記号の集合体」として成立している。
- 与えられたキャラクターの顔が、混沌の濃淡・配置から自然に浮かび上がる。
- 色はモノクロ＋赤アクセントのみ。
- 紙とインクの手描き的質感を保持している。
